ideas: Ransomware group ShinyHunters breached Match Group and Panera Bread
Millions of user records compromised, including PII and tracking data
Users can protect themselves by changing passwords and enabling 2FA
Monitoring digital footprint can help detect potential breaches
Single-Sign-On platforms and voice-cloning techniques used in breaches
